info.name: NEYU Health API (local)
info.description:
Run against your PC: npm run dev → baseUrl http://localhost:3000.
Order matters inside each folder (sign in first — Postman keeps the session cookie).
Origin header is required: the API rejects requests from other sites (CSRF protection).
Variables: patientEmail / patientPassword (demo patient).
staffEmail / staffPassword: easiest is the super admin from your .env (SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME / SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD) — password only, no 2-step code.
If you use an account with 2-step on, also set totpSecret = the key under 'Can't scan? Type this key' (Postman makes the 6-digit code from it).

request.description: Anonymous: only the browser session id is kept. Ignored when the browser sends Do Not Track.
Creates a new account each run (timestamped email). Needs a working email setup to receive the code; the account is created either way.

exec: // Remember an existing report, so 'Download' still works when the upload below is a duplicate (409) on a re-run.
const j = pm.response.json(); const id = (j.document||j.doc||j).id; if (id) pm.collectionVariables.set('docId', id);
pm.test('4 consents with policy version', () => { pm.expect(j.consents.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(j.consents.find(x => x.kind === 'terms').version).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Admin sign in · step 1 (username or email + password)

exec: pm.test('signed in, or asks for the 2-step code', () => {
if (j.step === 'setup') throw new Error('2-step is not set up yet: sign in once at /admin in the browser and scan the QR code first.');

item.name: Admin sign in · step 2 (2-step code — skipped for password-only accounts)

exec: // If this fails with 'code isn't right' right after another run: wait 30 seconds (each code works once).
// Password-only accounts (like the .env super admin) are already signed in after step 1.
// Makes the 6-digit code from totpSecret (the key shown under 'Can't scan? Type this key' when you set up 2-step).
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set totpSecret (your 2-step key) — see the collection description.');
for (const ch of secret) { const i = A.indexOf(ch); if (i < 0) throw new Error('totpSecret has a wrong character: ' + ch); bits += i.toString(2).padStart(5, '0'); }
let hex = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) hex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
pm.test('10 features to choose from', () => pm.expect(j.features.length).to.eql(10));
pm.test('every person is a super admin or an admin', () => j.staff.forEach((s) => pm.expect(['super', 'admin']).to.include(s.kind)));

item.name: Patient record → asks for a reason (break-glass)

exec: pm.test('reason asked (403) — or already open from a reason in the last 60 min (200)', () => {
pm.test('roles + menu', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.roles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.nav).to.include('settings'); });

pm.test('400 validation_error with field', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('validation_error'); pm.expect(e.details[0].path).to.eql('limit'); });
pm.test('200, or reason asked (super admin: privacy needs a reason)', () => pm.expect([200, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Anonymous: what people view, search, click and ask Neyu; where they come from.

item.name: Add an admin (Insights only) · API v1

request.description: Only a super admin can add people. Password left empty = a strong one is made and returned once.
Signs this Postman session in as the new admin.

item.name: New admin: menu shows only Insights

exec: pm.test('Insights yes, Patients and Audit no', () => { pm.expect(j.nav).to.include('insights'); pm.expect(j.nav).to.not.include('patients'); pm.expect(j.nav).to.not.include('audit'); });
pm.test('does not say which part was wrong', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/username or password/));

request.description: One wrong try. 5 in a row lock a normal account for 15 minutes (npm run staff -- unlock <username>). The .env super admin is never locked; only the per-network limit applies.

item.name: 5 · NEYU phone app (Phase 6)
item.description: What the NEYU iPhone / Android app calls: push notifications, Apple Health / Health Connect sync, sign-in to Withings/Oura/WHOOP from the phone.

exec: pm.test('signed in with id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.signedIn).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: The app keeps each person's phone settings apart by this id.

item.name: Push: can the server reach phones

exec: pm.test('has configured + phones', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.configured).to.have.keys('android','ios'); pm.expect(j.phones).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: The NEYU app sends its Firebase / Apple token here.

exec: pm.test('200 when push is set up on the server, 409 when not, 429 if repeated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,409,429]));

item.name: Devices: Android from the website = Notify me
Devices: Android from the app = sync token

exec: pm.test('token', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.match(/^anra_dev_/); pm.collectionVariables.set('deviceToken', t); });

request.description: Health Connect (Android) and Apple Health (iPhone) connect from the app.

item.name: Ingest: daily values from the phone
Withings/Oura/WHOOP from the app: one-time link

exec: pm.test('200 with a link when Oura is set up, 409 when not', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,409]); if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.expect(pm.response.json().url).to.match(/\/start\?h=/); });
